# Paths in ai-hero/wayfare-skills that auto-approve never approves; a person
# must. Each one ships to every consumer on merge, decides what runs on a
# plugin user's or maintainer's machine without being asked, or guards this
# list.
#
# auto-approve.yaml reads this file from main, never from the PR it judges,
# so a PR cannot shorten the list that judges it. The file also lists itself,
# so a PR cannot shorten it for every PR after it.
#
# One bash glob per line, matched against the whole path, ignoring case (a
# case-insensitive checkout loads `.MCP.json` as `.mcp.json`); `*` matches
# across `/`. A line starting with `#` is a comment; a `#` anywhere else is
# part of the pattern, so an entry with a trailing comment never matches.
# Blank lines are ignored. A list with no entries fails closed.

# The reusable workflow ~25 repos run at @main, and the caller every
# consumer's copy is held to byte for byte.
.github/workflows/auto-approve.yaml
assets/auto-approve/caller.yaml
.github/auto-approve-human-review.txt

# Hooks run in every session of everyone with the plugin enabled, and the
# Stop hook sources hero-lib.sh.
hooks/*
scripts/hero-lib.sh

# Manifests decide what installs and can register hooks or MCP servers
# anywhere in the tree: Claude Code's, then other agents'.
.claude-plugin/*
.mcp.json
plugin.json
.agents/plugins/*

# What Claude Code loads from a plugin root with no manifest edit: language
# servers start a process when a matching file opens, and root settings,
# agents, commands and output styles shape every session.
.lsp.json
settings.json
agents/*
commands/*
output-styles/*

# Run for a maintainer who opens this checkout, which is also the installed
# plugin and holds a token that can approve fleet-wide.
.claude/*
.vscode/*
